title: AdaKerNet: Neural Kernel Decoding for Task-Adaptive Prediction with Multimodal Large Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.36368v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large foundation models have been introduced with the promise of efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. Yet, under limited supervision, MLLMs, an important class of large foundation models, remain challenging to adapt to various downstream tasks. Adaptation typically relies either on MLLM parameter fine-tuning or on training neural-based decoders. Both approaches struggle under limited supervision, while fine-tuning additionally requires access to model parameters, which is often unavailable for closed-source models. We introduce AdaKerNet, a novel learnable task-adaptive neural kernel decoder. AdaKerNet is fully agnostic to the parameters of the underlying MLLM and operates solely on its (frozen) rich representations obtained from the diverse available modalities. translated_title: AdaKerNet：基于神经核解码的多模态大模型任务自适应预测
translated_abstract: 大型基础模型的提出旨在实现对下游任务的高效适应。然而，在监督有限的情况下，作为大型基础模型重要类别的多模态大模型（MLLM）仍然难以适应各种下游任务。现有适应方法通常依赖于MLLM参数微调或训练基于神经网络的解码器。这两种方法在监督有限的条件下都表现不佳，而微调还需要访问模型参数，这对于闭源模型来说通常是不可行的。我们提出了AdaKerNet，一种新颖的可学习任务自适应神经核解码器。AdaKerNet完全无需访问底层MLLM的参数，仅利用其从多种可用模态获得的（冻结的）丰富表示进行工作。AdaKerNet依赖于：（i）从这些MLLM表示中导出的一组可学习的、受Lipschitz约束控制的多模态特征；（ii）提供软……
tldr: AdaKerNet是一种与模型参数完全无关的任务自适应神经核解码器，仅利用冻结的多模态大模型表示，即可在有限监督下高效适应各种下游任务，尤其适用于无法访问模型参数的闭源模型场景。
en_tdlr: AdaKerNet is a fully parameter-agnostic, task-adaptive neural kernel decoder that operates solely on frozen multimodal LLM representations, enabling efficient adaptation to downstream tasks under limited supervision, especially for closed-source models.
